title.narrative: Livelihood Pathway through digital access- Dalit (Phase-II)

description.narrative:
This project is related with PRJ1710 and this project participants will remain same and during from 1st January to 30 June 2025. To ensure the long-term sustainability of the proposed project, a mechanism will be established to collect small contributions from the students participating in the program. This approach not only promotes a sense of ownership and responsibility among the beneficiaries but also serves as a practical way to create a self-sustaining financial resource for the project. The collected contributions will be securely deposited into a separate bank account specifically opened and designated for this purpose. This dedicated account will ensure transparent and efficient management of the funds, with strict oversight to align with the project’s objectives.
Once the project officially concludes, the accumulated funds will be strategically utilized to continue supporting key activities initiated during the project period. This could include maintaining resources, conducting follow-up activities, providing necessary support to the students, and addressing any emerging needs of the community. The proposed intervention will build on the project's achievements and incorporate lessons learned. It will emphasize the importance of Wi-Fi access points, IT hubs, and ICT-based training to promote digital technology for market access. The project aims to popularize e-commerce and create market opportunities through digital tools. With a proof of concept already established, this project is expected to develop a prototype for further advancing the innovative idea of using the internet to drive socio-economic development and empower the poor youth, young, and potential men and women of the Dalit community in Khulna and Satkhira.
